method: Read-only polygon-clipping diagnosis using EACH CASE OWN cached .v8 source, application selectionPose, scaledBBox and makeProjection, with current outsideLandmarks rules applied per original source polygon, then the 0.04 mm2 footprint filter. No build or Manifold. Areas use projected coordinates and conversion from mm2 to m2. A previous calculation using complet source under all three poses is superseded: each case has different source polygons after loadRegion/combineBuildings.

rotatedNeighbourTrace.statement: Polygons 284 and 285 belonged to the complet combined source. The actual girat combined source has 507 polygons and neither of these visible neighbours under ID 89672950. Its visible numeric source is only the Purissima fragment. Their coverage by ICGC in the actual girat region is recorded below; this is pre-catalogue combineBuildings provenance, not catalogue deletion.

fragmentDetail.interpretation: Small coarse polygon representing part of Purissima, not a detached neighbouring building. It intersects the independently identified Purissima OSM outline and municipal roof parts. The uncovered remainder is a narrow boundary-registration fragment, not a separate wing. The current per-polygon majority heuristic removes this 3.911 m2 fragment in all three real cached regions; it does not remove the remaining distant polygons globally.
fragmentDetail.validationPolicy: The numeric ID may be listed only as an expected removed baseline ID in local tests for all three actual cached regions; do not add it to catalogue replacement IDs. The previous expectation of retaining ID 89672950 in girat was based on reprojecting complet cache and is explicitly superseded. Use each cache own source and the ICGC coverage trace for the neighbouring polygons.
